_readme: Shared BSC contract address book for the BNB Agent Studio Marketplace agents.
Spec section 13: 'Do NOT allow individual developers to independently hardcode or
invent protocol addresses.' This file is the single source of truth; agents
load it, they do not embed their own copies.
EVERY address here was verified by calling it on the live chain, not copied
from documentation. Two traps this file encodes, both confirmed by calling:
'Router V3' (0xEfF92A26...) that have NO CODE on BSC mainnet.
* quoter_v2 is effectively SWAPPED between the networks: both contracts
exist on both chains, but 0xbC203d7f only answers on testnet and
0xB048Bbc1 only on mainnet. The wrong one reverts with a bare
Also note position_manager DIFFERS per network even though factory is
IDENTICAL on both. Re-verify with `python test_blockchain.py --live`, which
checks every address on both chains.
